description: Make the repository installable, buildable without secrets, and checkable by CI: pin the public npm registry, resync the lockfile so npm ci works, resolve DATABASE_URL lazily, and add typecheck, verify, and a CI workflow.
Add the glob-discovered eval runner over src/eval/**/*.eval.ts, extract batch formatting and pagination windowing into pure modules, and lock both with hermetic evals.
Add AGENTS.md, the always-on rule set under .agents/rules, and a manifest eval that fails when a rule is unindexed or a documented link does not resolve.

Add the durable harness state the planner reads and writes: vision, category weights, feature list, progress log, config, horizon, and the context refresh script, with a schema eval enforcing the feature list invariants.
Add the planner, executor, and validator prompt personas plus a contract eval asserting each prompt still emits the artifact schema the orchestration layer parses.
Add the merge watcher, worktree continuation, provider adapters, and pre-push guards that turn a merge to main into a reviewed draft pull request.
verify: npm run lint:shell && npm run watch:dry-run

description: Add a zero-dependency reporter over the run event stream so a continuation can be inspected after the fact by run, by feature, or as a summary.
Add dependency audit, secret scanning, and code scanning workflows, the manual continuation fallback, the autonomy model document, and a branch ruleset staged for later application.
Seed the product roadmap from the vision into this file and set the opening horizon slice so the planner has real product work to select from on its first run.

Add the /companies/[id] route. Every company card already links there and the route does not exist, so all 24 cards on every page currently lead to a 404. Render the full profile from the existing columns: description, website, batch, team size, location, tags, industries, status, and last synced date.

Replace the placeholder 'Create Next App' title and description in the root layout with real metadata, and export getCompaniesWithOffset from src/db/index.ts. The page imports it from the query module directly while every sibling query is re-exported, so the barrel is misleading about the module's surface.

Stop selecting the embedding column in queries whose callers never read it. getCompanyById and getAllCompanies each pull a full vector per row across the wire for no consumer. Keep it only where similarity scoring needs it.

Remove the 'use client' directive from the company grid. It holds no state, runs no effect, and touches no browser API, so it ships client JavaScript for markup the server could render. Keep the card on the client, since it owns image error state.

Add loading and error boundaries for the listing and detail routes. A failed database call currently renders an inline error block on the listing and nothing at all on the detail route, and there is no loading state while a server component awaits.

Generate and store embeddings for companies. The schema has the column, searchCompanies takes a query vector, and nothing produces one, so semantic search is unreachable. Build the embedding module, backfill existing rows in batches, and keep new and updated rows current.

Expose hybrid search through a validated route that embeds the query and calls searchCompanies. Validate input at the boundary, bound the result set, and keep the existing semantic, trigram, and full-text weighting behind a single named constant.

Lock the hybrid ranking with a hermetic eval over fixed vectors and rows, asserting the ordering the weights are meant to produce. Changing the weights changes what users see, so it must fail loudly rather than pass a build silently.

Add the search surface: an input that drives a server-rendered result set, keeps the query in the URL so results are shareable, and has real empty, loading, and error states. Reuse the existing card and design tokens.

Ingest and refresh company records from their source, updating last_synced_at and re-embedding what changed. Must be resumable and idempotent, so a partial run leaves consistent state rather than half-updated rows.

Add the background research runtime the repository is named for: run an enrichment task per company, persist its output, and degrade gracefully when a source fails. A partial result must be recorded as partial and never read as complete.
Attach a source and a timestamp to every enriched claim, and surface both in the interface, so a reader can tell what is known, what is inferred, and what is stale.
Measure research coverage and freshness with a hermetic eval over recorded fixtures, so quality is demonstrable in CI rather than asserted, and a regression in enrichment shows up as a failure.

Emit one structured event per search request: outcome, phase timings, latency bucket, result count, and a bounded query prefix. Search can fail in three different ways and none of them are currently visible after the response is sent.

Make database access survive a bad minute: retry transient failures with jittered backoff, bound search with a statement timeout, apply the vector index setting inside the query's own transaction rather than a separate statement that never reaches it, and stop returning driver text to callers.

Run research on a cadence rather than by hand: pick the companies whose newest finding is stale or missing first, cap how many run at once so a schedule cannot become a stampede, and record what was skipped and why.

Add a second research source so a profile does not rest on one page: collect from a careers or jobs surface, declare it in RESEARCH_SOURCES, and let a run be genuinely partial when one source reports and the other does not.

Once real multi-source research runs are recorded into the fixture corpus, extend the quality bar's expected fields to include careers findings so coverage measures the second source rather than only website title and description.

Grow the research quality fixture corpus with multi-source runs shaped like what DEFAULT_COLLECTORS produce: website plus careers findings on complete runs, and at least one genuine partial where careers fails while website succeeds (so partialShare reflects two-source honesty). Keep EXPECTED_FIELDS as website_title and website_description only; do not raise the careers coverage bar yet. Adjust QUALITY_BAR only if the new mix would fail the existing website bar for reasons other than careers coverage. Optionally tighten the corpus shape eval so attempted and succeeded sources are members of RESEARCH_SOURCES. This recording unlocks research-careers-quality-fields.
Emit one structured event per research run (status, sources attempted and failed, schedule skip reasons, timings) mirroring search-observability, so unattended research is inspectable after the fact.
Surface the collector name on each evidence row so readers can tell website claims from careers claims without decoding field names.

Carry FindingConfidence through toEvidenceItems onto each EvidenceItem with a closed human-readable label (High / Medium / Low), and render it as a secondary Badge on each evidence row beside the collector and freshness badges.

Fix the company Research section so a failed latest run never claims findings come from earlier runs (the detail page only loads getLatestResearchRun), and surface the latest run status plus observed_at with closed reader labels (Complete / Partial / Failed) so a reader can tell what this run actually is without decoding a misleading banner. Extract pure status-label and notice-copy helpers, lock them with a hermetic eval, keep CompanyEvidence a Server Component.

Assert the company source identity uniqueness that ingestion already assumes: add a human-applied migration that creates a unique index on companies (source, source_id), and change insertCompanyFromSource to a parameterized INSERT ... ON CONFLICT (source, source_id) DO NOTHING RETURNING id, falling back to getCompanyBySource when no row is returned, so a concurrent double-insert cannot create duplicates. Lock the migration unique-index shape and the conflict target with a hermetic eval that reads the migration file and the insert SQL source. Do not change refresh-plan decisions, embedding pipeline, research collectors, hybrid weights, UI, or QUALITY_BAR.

Load prior research runs for a company so a failed latest run can honestly surface earlier findings when they exist, instead of only showing the latest run. Keep status honesty from research-evidence-run-honesty; extend the data loaded for the Research section without inventing findings the store does not have.

Fix the company detail Research section so a failed getRecentResearchRuns read never collapses to an empty run list that renders as never-researched. Distinguish load failure from true empty history with closed, generic reader copy that never includes driver or query error text. Thread a success/failure signal through CompanyDetail into CompanyEvidence, keep CompanyEvidence a Server Component, extract pure empty-state copy helpers, and lock them with a hermetic eval.

Extend withRetry to the company listing and count reads (getCompaniesWithOffset, getCompanyCount, getAllCompanies) so browse and pagination degrade gracefully on transient database failures the same way search already does. Do not change SQL shapes, hybrid weights, or UI copy beyond real error states.

Add a hermetic or fixture-backed measure of embedding coverage so hybrid search readiness is measurable: how many companies have usable embeddings versus how many would fall back to name/full-text only. Lock the coverage invariant with an eval; do not change embedding generation or hybrid weights.

Add a human-applied migration that creates a non-unique index on company_research_findings (run_id) so getRecentResearchRuns findings lookups (WHERE run_id = $1 or OR of two ids) can use an Index/Bitmap scan instead of relying on a foreign key that does not create a child-column index in Postgres. Keep the migration human-applied like 0001/0002 (comment that the agent loop never applies DDL). Lock the index shape with a hermetic eval that reads migrations/*.sql. Do not change research query TypeScript, collectors, UI, hybrid weights, QUALITY_BAR, or ingestion.

Surface company profile sync freshness with the same bands readers already see on research evidence: map last_synced_at through freshnessOf and relativeAge (clock injected as now) into closed labels matching CompanyEvidence (Fresh / Aging / Stale / Age unknown), replace the absolute-only formatSyncedAt Last synced row on company detail with a secondary Badge for the band, relative age text, and a machine-readable time element with dateTime, keep CompanyDetail a Server Component, extract pure helpers that accept Date or string, and lock them with a hermetic eval under src/eval/. Do not change research collectors, SQL, hybrid weights, QUALITY_BAR, company cards, listing/search UI, or observability emitters.
Bound collector response.text() size so unattended research cannot OOM on huge HTML pages. Keep collectors otherwise unchanged; lock the bound with a hermetic eval.

Block research collector fetches to non-public destinations so unattended website and careers collection cannot probe loopback, link-local, private, or cloud-metadata hosts. Reject unsafe hosts on the initial URL and on every redirect hop (do not use unchecked redirect:'follow'). When a destination is blocked, fail that source (throw) so the run is partial or failed rather than silently succeeding after an internal probe. Share one pure guard used by both collectors. Lock the blocked-host set and redirect revalidation with a hermetic eval.

Reject non-HTML research collector response bodies before parse so unattended website and careers fetches fail the source on unexpected Content-Type instead of feeding binary or JSON into HTML extractors. Keep the SSRF guard and body byte cap; lock Content-Type gating with a hermetic eval.

Extract the head-parsing layer duplicated verbatim between the website and careers collectors (title and description regexes, the single-pass entity decode, the value collapse and 300 character cap, and the fetch timeout) into one shared module both collectors import. The duplication means a parse fix can land in one source and silently miss the other. No parse behaviour change; lock the shared helpers and the absence of the duplicated literals with a hermetic eval.

Lock the invariant the runtime already assumes: DEFAULT_COLLECTORS covers every member of RESEARCH_SOURCES exactly once, with no collector for a source that is not declared. Adding a source to RESEARCH_SOURCES without a collector currently ships a source that is never attempted, which no eval or type error catches. Add a pure coverage helper and a hermetic eval over the real runtime wiring.

Fall back to og:description and og:title when a page declares no name="description" or no title, so a company whose site ships Open Graph tags instead of classic head tags still produces findings instead of an empty successful run. Keep the shared cap and single-pass decode, tolerate reversed attribute order, and lock the fallback precedence with a hermetic eval.

Point each finding at the page the site itself considers canonical: when a fetched page declares <link rel="canonical"> and it resolves to an http(s) URL on the same host as the request, use it as evidence_url instead of the fetched URL. Reject cross-host, non-http(s), and unparseable canonicals, so a page cannot redirect a readers evidence link somewhere the collector never visited. Lock same-host acceptance and cross-host rejection with a hermetic eval.

Replace the raw error message a failed source stores on a research run with a closed set of reason codes (blocked destination, timeout, HTTP status, oversize body, non-HTML body, source failed). Collector failures currently persist and render whatever the thrown Error said, which can carry the fetched URL and its query string into the database and onto the company page. Classify at the runtime boundary, keep the closed codes readable, and lock the classification with a hermetic eval.

Narrow ResearchSourceFailure.error from string to the ResearchFailureReason union so the closed set is enforced by the compiler rather than only at the runtime boundary, and fold an unrecognised stored value to source_failed when reading rows back. Rows written before the reason codes landed still hold raw messages, so the read path has to narrow them rather than trust them.

Drop duplicate findings within a single research run, keyed on source and field, keeping the first. A collector can now reach one field through more than one tag (description or og:description, title or og:title) and a run flattens every source outcome into a single findings list, so the same claim is storable twice. A reader would see it twice and the coverage measure would count it twice.

Finish the pass db-resilience and listing-db-resilience started: getCompanyById returns the raw driver error.message to its caller, and listCompaniesMissingEmbeddings and updateCompanyEmbedding have no retry at all. Close the company read error, wrap the remaining queries in withRetry, keep the two messages callers branch on, and lock both requirements for every query in src/db with a source eval that cannot pass vacuously.
